# claude-code-plan-and-execution

> A two-command Claude Code workflow: /make-plan writes a self-contained plan
> file with an expensive model, /execute-plan runs it in a fresh session with a
> cheap orchestrator that delegates every code change to model-pinned worker
> agents and gates the risky phases behind an expensive read-only reviewer.

The links below point at raw markdown — that is the complete content, no
rendering needed. The skill and agent files are the workflow itself, not
documentation about it.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/docs/index.md): What the workflow is, the shape in one screen, and the scope of the claims.
- [Design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/docs/design.md): The six roles, the phase packet, the git discipline that closes a real review hole, and when not to use any of this.
- [Gotchas](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/docs/gotchas.md): The failure modes that break the setup silently. `scripts/doctor.sh` asserts the checkable ones.
- [Prompting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/docs/prompting.md): What changed with Opus 5 and Sonnet 5, and the prompt consequences — one inverts standard advice.
- [The advisor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/docs/advisor.md): What /advisor is, what is verified about it, and why it is off during orchestrated execution.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/README.md): Install, use, verification, and the three things that break it.

## The workflow files themselves

- [make-plan skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/skills/make-plan/SKILL.md): The planner. Research budget, plan-file contract, handoff.
- [execute-plan skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/skills/execute-plan/SKILL.md): The orchestrator loop. Delegation, review, gates, integration.
- [planning-researcher agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/agents/planning-researcher.md): Read-only breadth search during planning.
- [implementer agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/agents/implementer.md): Writes the code and the tests, one phase at a time.
- [quick-implementer agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/agents/quick-implementer.md): Mechanical, exactly-specified work. Refuses judgment.
- [plan-reviewer agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/agents/plan-reviewer.md): Read-only risk gate over the real changes.
- [Plan template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/templates/PLAN-TEMPLATE.md): The plan-file contract every plan fills in.

## Optional

- [Test wrapper example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/templates/bin/test-example.sh): The wrapper convention that keeps test logs out of agent context.
- [Settings snippet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/templates/settings.snippet.json): plansDirectory and the read-only permission allowlist.
- [CLAUDE.md snippet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekstremedia/claude-code-plan-and-execution/main/templates/CLAUDE.md.snippet.md): The two-line routing note, and why it is deliberately that short.
